{
  "summary": "Changed session title from hardcoded 'nezha-agent-session' to dynamic 'nezha-{agentId}' using Config.getInstance().getAgentId(). This allows identifying which agent created the session.",
  "learnings": [
    {"topic": "Testing", "reminder": "Always add tests when modifying transport/HttpTransport - check for existing test patterns in __tests__/ directory before implementing"},
    {"topic": "Error handling", "reminder": "Config.getInstance() can throw if not initialized - consider adding fallback or error handling for getAgentId()"},
    {"topic": "TypeScript patterns", "reminder": "Check return type of Config methods - getAgentId() returns string, ensure agentId is never undefined before using in titles"},
    {"topic": "Breaking changes", "reminder": "Session title format change may affect server-side logging/filtering - document this API change"}
  ],
  "issues": [
    "No null/undefined check on agentId - if Config returns undefined, session title becomes 'nezha-undefined'",
    "No error handling around Config.getInstance().getAgentId() call",
    "No test coverage for HttpTransport.createSession() or doCreateSession()"
  ],
  "suggestions": [
    "Add fallback: const agentId = Config.getInstance().getAgentId() || 'unknown'",
    "Add unit test for doCreateSession() mocking Config and fetch",
    "Document that session titles now follow 'nezha-{agentId}' format"
  ],
  "praise": "Correct use of ES module import with .js extension. Proper use of singleton pattern via Config.getInstance(). Dynamic session naming is more useful than hardcoded string.",
  "findings": [
    "Line 142: agentId could potentially be undefined if Config.getAgentId() returns undefined - recommend adding || 'default' fallback",
    "No __tests__/transports/ directory exists - task warning is valid",
    "The change introduces a dependency on Config being initialized before HttpTransport.createSession() is called"
  ],
  "overallScore": 75,
  "codeQualityScore": 80,
  "testCoverageScore": 30,
  "documentationScore": 60
}
